question: What additional portion should be allotted to the head of the liṅgas?
premises: An excess portion for liṅgas is prescribed
The portion relates to the head
It consists of a curvature part
inference: One should give the excess of the liṅgas as the curvature part of the head.
uncertainties: The exact technical sense of vartanāṃśaka may vary by tradition
plain_english: One should give the excess of the liṅgas as the curvature portion of the head.
